Hi there! The quickest way to tell if the problem you’re seeing is a platform‑wide incident or something specific to your workspace is to check our status page.

1. Open the status page and look at the component‑level breakdown. If there’s an incident listed for the API, dashboard, or any other component during the time you’re experiencing the issue, that means it’s a broader outage.
2. If nothing appears for that time window, the slowdown is most likely local to your environment – for example, a browser extension, your network conditions, or a large data load in your workspace.

So, start by reviewing the status page; it will show the exact start/end times and affected components for any incident. If you don’t see anything matching your symptoms, it’s probably an isolated/local issue.
